metadata.description: Essential productivity and telemetry plugins for omp: Conventional Commits, Think Hard (+), Use Smol (_), Token Meter, Sub Meter, After queue, and Image Preview.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: /commit asks commit + push, commit only or new branch, then splits changes into Conventional Commits.

plugins.name: think-hard
plugins.description: Start a prompt with + and that turn thinks at max reasoning effort.

plugins.name: use-smol
plugins.description: Start a prompt with _ to run that turn on a fast/smol model (Haiku/Flash/smol).

plugins.name: token-meter
plugins.description: Live turn tokens (in, out, cache) and session total in the TUI status bar and /tokens command.

plugins.name: sub-meter
plugins.description: Subscription and rate-limit tracker (5h / 7d windows) as visual progress bar in TUI status and /sub-meter command.

plugins.name: after
plugins.description: Prompt queue: /after <task> queues tasks to run when current task finishes without steering.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Cross-platform terminal image preview tool and /preview-image command with half-block truecolor and ASCII support.
